purpose: Define the repository quality, security, coverage, dependency, release, and publication-evidence gates required before public-surface completion claims.

coverage.pythonGate: .github/workflows/pr-ci.yml runs pytest with --cov-fail-under=90 and uploads Codecov with fail_ci_if_error.
coverage.rustGate: .github/workflows/pr-ci.yml runs cargo fmt, cargo audit, cargo clippy -D warnings, and cargo test for the Rust workspace.

quality.python: ruff format --check, ruff check, docstring lint, and ty --error all run before tests.
quality.rust: cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, and cargo test run in PR CI.
quality.slowValidation: property, mutation, and profiling jobs are available through slow-validation workflows.

security.python: security-focused Ruff rules, bandit, and pip-audit run in PR CI.
security.rust: cargo audit runs in PR CI.
security.codeScanning: CodeQL runs on pull requests, pushes to master, and weekly schedule.
security.dependencyReview: dependency-review-action uses .github/dependency-review-config.yml and fails at high or worse severity.

dependencyAutomation.renovate: renovate.json covers Python, GitHub Actions, Cargo, npm, Go modules, Gradle, NuGet, and Dockerfile managers.
dependencyAutomation.dependencyDashboard: Dependency dashboard approval is required for grouped package-manager updates.

versioning.repo: Git tags and release workflows are the repository version source of truth.
versioning.packages: Package manifests carry explicit versions or tag conventions, and release evidence binds package versions to source commit/tag/checksum.

surfaces.externalGate: CRAN acceptance remains an external reviewer gate.
Maven Central namespace, signing, and close/release state remain external service gates.
MATLAB File Exchange publication remains an external account/reviewer gate.
SSC acceptance remains a maintainer-review gate.

surfaces.runtimeConstraint: Native runtime execution must be separately evidenced before completion claims.
